description: Turn any text into big ASCII art banners with a built-in 5×7 pixel font — copy it or download as a .txt file.

faqs.a: A real 5×7 bitmap font is built into the tool covering A–Z, 0–9 and common punctuation. Letters you type are matched case-insensitively.
Yes — every glyph is drawn from pixel data, so it works fully offline in your browser.
Use the plain-text download and paste it into a code editor or terminal with a monospace font for perfect alignment.
faqs.q: How do I keep the alignment when sharing?

howto: Type your text (letters, numbers, basic punctuation).
Pick a fill character and optional letter spacing.
Copy it or download as a .txt file.
title: ASCII Art Text Banner
